title: Mezzos's Emerald Ticket
description: Turns the emerald item in minecraft into a ticket
body:
# Welcome to the Emerald Ticket Resourcepack!

**This resourcepack replaces the minecraft:emerald with a ticket texture (look pictures)** The new emerald then can be found as "Ticket" in the creative tab. Please mind, that the emerald will always be the ticket, as long as the resourcepack is activated.
How the ticket looks like ![This shows the new emerald texture as a ticket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d82a6fe310a9fdb2c8c98af29cf9a19f8bad6ed3.png)
## Important **This resourcepack shows the correct translation for following languages.** Otherwise it will show as "Ticket" - ✅English (US) - ✅German - ✅English (GB) - ✅French - ✅Russian - ✅Spanish - ✅Italian - ✅Simplified Chinese ### Other planed languages: If you want to suggest more languages feel free to join my discord :) ## Please report any bugs or errors on my discord
